name: New Active Directory User Created
xql_query:
dataset = microsoft_windows_raw
| filter event_id = "4720"
| alter CreatedUser = json_extract_scalar(event_data ,"$.SamAccountName")
| alter CreatingUser = json_extract_scalar(event_data , "$.SubjectUserName")
| alter DomainName = json_extract_scalar(event_data , "$.SubjectDomainName")
| alter DisplayUserName = json_extract_scalar(event_data , "$.DisplayName")
alert_description: Creation of a Custom Alert to notify every time a new Active Directory account is created

TA0004 - Privilege Escalation: T1037.001 - Boot or Logon Initialization Scripts: Logon Script (Windows)
